prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist.

Task: Build a useful SEO content strategy.

Input context:
- BUSINESS: [BUSINESS]
- CONTENT INVENTORY: [CONTENT INVENTORY]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- SEARCH DATA: [SEARCH DATA]

Map real audience questions to existing pages. Identify useful gaps, consolidation opportunities and evidence needs. Prioritise original content and internal links. Avoid keyword-padding, unsupported volumes and duplicate pages created only to target variations.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Workshop content plan
Begin with programme, equipment and beginner questions. Consolidate two pages answering the same question before adding another article. Use actual Search Console queries when available and validate local details. Track useful enquiries alongside search performance. Priorities remain provisional without data, and no ranking or traffic increase is promised.
